description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 6685011790154 HYGROMETER,DIAL IND: Line 0001 Qty 103 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0115 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
